Name: Wispr Keys
Author: Sree
Description: Drive Wispr Flow from Stream Deck: dictation toggle, push-to-talk (real Fn), Lens, Polish, Scratchpad and deep links.

Actions.Name: Dictate (toggle)
Actions.Tooltip: Press to start hands-free dictation, press again to stop.

Actions.Name: Wispr Shortcut
Actions.Tooltip: Presses a Wispr shortcut with real key events (Fn works). Settings: keys e.g. opt+1, hold for push-to-talk.

Actions.Name: Wispr Link
Actions.Tooltip: Opens a Wispr deep link: start-hands-free, stop-hands-free, switch-mic, open.
